title: HTTP Upstream Dispatcher Config
description: Configuration for the HTTP upstream reverse proxy dispatcher plugin

url.description: Base URL of the upstream (e.g., https://api.example.com). Exclusive with endpoints.

endpoints.description: Instances of the upstream; each request goes to one, by weighted round-robin, skipping instances whose circuit breaker is open. Exclusive with url.

retries.description: With endpoints: how many other endpoints a failed request may be sent to, within timeout. A request that never reached its endpoint is retried whatever its method; one that was sent, only when its method is idempotent.

path.description: Path template for the upstream request. Supports {param} substitution from path parameters. If not specified, uses the original request path.

tls.description: TLS settings for the upstream connection. Paths are PEM files under BARBACANE_SECRETS_DIR.

client_cert.description: Client certificate for mutual TLS. Requires client_key.

client_key.description: Private key of the client certificate. Requires client_cert.

ca.description: CA certificate the upstream's certificate is verified against, in place of the system roots.
